decisions.basis: Source-fidelity/currentness are not invented FOL predicates
decisions.choice: Separate logical obligation manifest from administrative and semantic-review gates; require both in the total manifest

decisions.basis: A caller cannot shrink the denominator
decisions.choice: Generate consistency and joint-population targets and independent gates before comparing any submission
Bind theory/signature, current policy bytes, exact sources, assumed context and change class

decisions.basis: Provider verification and aggregation are later units
decisions.choice: Comparison validates required-set identity only, never submitted proof truth

obligation_coverage: All generation/comparison criteria mapped; actual proof/source reviews remain future evidence.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Omitted, substituted or weakened required obligation is rejected; all negative controls are checked against the independently required statement set.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Derive requirements from reviewed relation policy, signature and change class; generate a manifest with exact statements, strength and prerequisites; input submitters cannot shrink the denominator.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Omitted, substituted or weakened required obligation is rejected; all negative controls are checked against the independently required statement set.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
